list: Official 55-trophy list as published on PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, 18 Nov 2026): 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden. No online trophies.
note: Names and descriptions are the official PlayStation text. Every guide below is written in my own words for this entry; the sources named beside each guide are where the facts come from. Four trophies had their methods confirmed on 20 November 2026 and are marked newly confirmed. Where a method is still unconfirmed, the guide says so plainly instead of inventing steps.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: This one arrives on its own once the other 54 are all done, so there is no separate task attached to it. Clear the story, work through the side strands and the 100% checklist, mop up the one-off trophies in the cleanup stage, and the platinum will pop the instant the final one lands. PowerPyx estimates the whole journey at roughly 200 hours and rates it 4 out of 10 for difficulty.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order that suits the roadmap.
The platinum unlocks by itself as soon as the last remaining trophy pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: An early story trophy that cannot be missed. Play Gone Fishing, one of the first missions in Chapter 1, and see it through to its ending. The trophy appears when the mission wraps up, and there is nothing to set up beforehand.
steps: Begin the story and reach the mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1.
Play it to the end; the trophy pops at the mission-complete screen.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when Chapter 1 is finished. The chapter itself is straightforward, but before you leave it, handle the one thing in the whole game that can slip away: once the mission Down to Earth is done, speak with Lucia at Jason's house in the morning, walk with her out to the balcony and say yes when she suggests meditating. That single session may be needed for Positive Mental Attitude, and it cannot be repeated after Chapter 1 closes.
steps: Play every main mission of Chapter 1.
After Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house before the chapter ends.
The trophy pops as Chapter 1 closes.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when Chapter 2 is finished. From here on Jason and Lucia are both playable together, which opens the partner trophies and most of the side content, so it pays to take the optional missions as they show up instead of sprinting past them.
steps: Play every main mission of Chapter 2.
The trophy pops as Chapter 2 closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when Chapter 3 is finished. This chapter holds the mission behind Break the Bank, and by this point the robbery side content — bank vaults, armored trucks and illegal operations — is starting to open, so it is a sensible time to begin the crime trophies alongside the story.
steps: Play every main mission of Chapter 3.
The trophy pops as Chapter 3 closes.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: A story trophy that pops when Chapter 4 is finished. This is the chapter where the big bank-vault robberies become available through an optional mission, which feeds straight into Maximum Withdrawal, so keep a quick bike nearby whenever you go after a vault.
steps: Play every main mission of Chapter 4.
The trophy pops as Chapter 4 closes.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold that closes the story. Finish the final mission of Chapter 5. There is no mission replay in GTA 6, so make a manual save just before it — and ideally one at the start of every chapter — in case you ever want to go back. Once the credits roll you return to free roam, so nothing else is locked behind the ending.
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission.
Complete the final mission.
The trophy pops at the end of the story; free roam opens afterwards.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete Breakfast Run in Chapter 2. It shows up naturally as you work through the chapter; there is no side requirement and no way to skip past it.
steps: Reach and play Breakfast Run in Chapter 2.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3. It is a main-story beat, so it arrives on its own as you move through the chapter — just keep playing the story and it pops.
steps: Reach and play The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete Child's Play in Chapter 4. Like the other named-mission trophies it sits on the main path, so it cannot be skipped or missed.
steps: Reach and play Child's Play in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete Headliners in Chapter 4. It is part of the main story, so it unlocks as you play through the chapter in order.
steps: Reach and play Headliners in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4, set at Vice City International Airport. It is a main-mission beat; play the chapter through and it pops when the mission ends.
steps: Reach and play VCIA Takedown in Chapter 4.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy tied to one mission. Complete Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5. It is the last of the named-mission story trophies and arrives late in the story, so keep following the main path and it will come to you.
steps: Reach and play Operation Savage Glory in Chapter 5.
Finish the mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The toughest trophy in the set, and the gold that stands between you and the platinum. Reach 100% on the game's own checklist, which appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It holds 35 requirements in three groups — story and tasks, exploration and activities, discovery — but most targets are forgiving: they ask for only part of a set, such as 300 of the 397 stunts, 200 of the 277 vehicles, 100 of the 255 animals, 50 of the 66 weapons, 70 of the 80 challenges and 15 of the 18 card sets. The few that demand everything are the robberies, the underwater discoveries, the shooting ranges, the drone races and Bret's quests. Anything you do during the story already counts, and PowerPyx and GTABase both say nothing on the checklist is missable: it can all still be finished in free roam after the credits.
steps: Finish the story; the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work through its 35 requirements; partial sets count (for example 300 of 397 stunts).
Clear the full-requirement items last: all robberies, all 42 shooting-range golds, all drone races, all of Bret's quests.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Finish any 250 of the 397 stunts spread across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. The 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past 250 and this silver will pop along the way. Stunts are tracked in the Progress menu, and a plane or a fast bike makes the flying ones much easier.
steps: Look for stunt markers around Leonida; ramps and bridges are the easiest place to start.
Complete 250 stunts of any kind.
Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every type of activity in the game at least once. The activities cover fishing, hunting, bowling, arcade games, shooting ranges, drone races, races and meditation, among others. You only have to try each one, not win or finish it, so work through the activity list early and tick each type off as you sample it. The exact activity list was still being pinned down by guide sites on launch day, so use the in-game activities menu as the checklist and try anything you have not tried yet.
steps: Open the activities available in Leonida and try one of each type.
You only need to attempt each type once, not win it.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Take a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. Every challenge at every range has to be golded, and the 100% checklist demands the same 42, so this is one of the few all-or-nothing grinds. PowerPyx does not rate the challenges as hard; take them one weapon at a time, learn each range's target pattern, and retry the ones you miss — there is no penalty for failing and retrying.
steps: Visit each of the 12 shooting ranges.
Earn gold in all 42 challenges.
Track progress under Progress; retry any challenge until it is gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations. One win per location is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 42 races, so the trophy is the easy half of the job. Drone races are short and repeatable, so if you lose one, restart it right away and learn the course line before chasing the win.
steps: Find the Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
Win at least one race at every location.
All 42 races are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 available. Winning the same race twice does not count, so you need 20 distinct wins. Pick the vehicle class you are strongest in, learn each course's corners, and keep a note of which races you have already won so you do not waste time repeating them.
steps: Enter races around Leonida.
Win 20 different races; repeats of a race you already won do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Out-fish Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal texts you after a Chapter 1 mission and marks the fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Head to the marked spot, take the challenge and beat his catch. Fishing is one of the activity types, so this also counts toward trying the activities for Master of None.
steps: Wait for Cal's text after a Chapter 1 mission; it marks a purple icon on the map.
Go to the marked fishing spot and take the challenge.
Beat Cal's catch to win.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play any one arcade game through to its end. Find an arcade machine in Leonida, start a game and finish it. You do not need a high score or a perfect run — finishing one game is enough — and it also counts as trying an activity type for Master of None.
steps: Find an arcade machine.
Play and complete any one arcade game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: See Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Andy is one of the side characters with a multi-mission quest line; his jobs stay open after the story, so you can finish them in free roam. Note that Andy's strand does not count toward the 8 strands needed for Strangers & Freaks, so treat it as its own trophy.
steps: Find Andy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: See Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Kenton is a side character with his own quest line; like the other character strands, it stays available after the story, so there is no deadline — just work through his missions in order until the last one is done.
steps: Find Kenton's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: See Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. His five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after a Chapter 2 mission, and they stay open after the story, so you can do them whenever you like. Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for its own trophy.
steps: Go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission that unlocks it.
Complete all five of Billy's jobs, ending with his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands. Not every stranger counts: the strands that count include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, while the character quests for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not count toward this silver — those have their own trophies. Strangers & Freaks is not needed for the 100% checklist, so save it for the cleanup stage and work through the counting strangers one by one.
steps: Find stranger missions across Leonida (look for the stranger markers).
Complete 8 full strands that count — Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed counters.
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy or Billy strands; they have their own trophies and do not count here.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: See Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy is a side character with a multi-mission quest line that stays open after the story, so work through his jobs in order in free roam until the last one is done.
steps: Find Randy's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: See Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone is a side character with his own quest line, available after the story in free roam. His strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, so finish it for this trophy alone.
steps: Find Tyrone's missions and work through his strand.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY. Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations in Leonida. The danger is the first one: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating at Jason's house in the morning and walks out to the balcony — follow her and accept. That session becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1, and it is not yet confirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it to be safe. Two details from PowerPyx back that up: the Chapter 1 session adds +1 to the count in the Progress menu even though it is not labelled as a Meditation Spot like the rest, and PowerPyx's author earned the trophy having done that Chapter 1 session. The other spots are spread across the map — a sandbar west of Capri, Buckskin Swamp in Kelly County, a water wheel near the paper mill in Moreau, a waterfall in Lummox County, and the final one at the summit of Mount Kalaga, which only appears on the map after the previous spots are done. You can meditate as both Jason and Lucia at a spot, which counts twice toward the meditation counter. Track your count under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18, so this trophy needs more than 100% does.
steps: CHAPTER 1 — DO THIS FIRST: after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia at Jason's house, follow her to the balcony and accept the meditation.
Visit the remaining 17 spots (10 locations); meditate as both Jason and Lucia where you can.
The final spot is at the summit of Mount Kalaga and only appears after the others.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations until all 18 are done.

sources.name: Beebom — All GTA 6 Meditation Spots Locations

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a one-of-a-kind animal for Bret — but note the exact animal that pops the trophy is still unconfirmed, so do not chase a named creature yet. What is now confirmed is how the chain starts: Bret Vogel's quest line opens on its own after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. While you are playing as Jason you will get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive that message, so this whole strand is Jason-only, and it stays available after the story. After that first quest he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to Bret, still as Jason. During the first quest he hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up again from any weapon locker at an Ammu-Nation. Taking an animal down with one clean shot leaves it in pristine condition and pays more money, but that is a bonus, not a requirement. Keep an eye on your progress under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck. There are 15 Target Decks in total, and all of them are needed for the 100% checklist, so finish every Bret quest rather than stopping at this one trophy.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break; Bret's quest line then opens on its own.
As Jason, follow the text to Bret's first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County.
Hunt the animals he requests at his purple map icons and bring them to Bret as Jason.
Finish all of Bret's quests — the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Achievements & Trophies List (PS5 / Xbox Series)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish any 3 collectible card sets out of the 18 in the game. There are 480 cards in total, and the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so the three sets for this silver are just the start — keep collecting and you will pass this trophy long before you finish the checklist. Cards are found all over Leonida, so pick up every card you pass while doing other things.
steps: Collect cards as you explore Leonida.
Complete any 3 full sets.
The 100% checklist needs 15 of the 18 sets, so keep collecting.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations. Any mix counts: 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and No Flusher tags all add to the total. WAiNK It is the game's photo-tagging collectible, so snap everything the game lets you tag as you travel — the count builds up naturally if you tag landmarks and curiosities whenever you pass one.
steps: Open the WAiNK It feature at a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or tag spot.
WAiNK It at 100 locations in total, in any mix of categories.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. The 100% checklist wants 70, so this bronze pops two-thirds of the way there. Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more, and they tick off in the background as you play, so check the challenge list in the Progress menu and chase the easy ones first — you are allowed to skip the hardest 10 for 100%, and even more for this trophy.
steps: Check the challenge list under Progress.
Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges.
70 of 80 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. You need both protagonists together for this one, which is possible from Chapter 2 onward. Cause enough trouble to reach 4 stars, then break line of sight, get out of the search area and stay hidden until the stars clear — a fast car and the countryside help more than the city streets.
steps: Play with your partner alongside you (both protagonists, from Chapter 2).
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars.
Escape and lose the wanted level completely.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — meaning you must keep the heat on you the whole time, never dropping to zero stars between robberies. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob each quickly, and move straight to the next before the police lose you. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over.
steps: Bring your partner and pick three shops close together.
Rob the first shop to get a wanted level.
Rob the second and third shops back-to-back before the wanted level clears.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them. The game has 277 base-model vehicles, and the 100% checklist wants 200 of them, so this bronze is the halfway mark. Scan every new vehicle you see while driving around — traffic, parked cars, anything you have not scanned yet — and the count climbs on its own. Make scanning a habit during the story so you are not grinding it at the end.
steps: Scan vehicles you have not discovered yet.
Discover 100 vehicles.
200 of 277 are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Fill your Focus meter first, then find a spot with at least five enemies close together — a gang shootout or a police standoff works — activate Combat Focus with an assault rifle and drop five of them before the meter runs out. If you only get four, let the meter refill and try again.
steps: Fill your Combat Focus meter.
Find five or more enemies grouped together.
Activate Combat Focus with an assault rifle and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet at Vice City International Airport and take off with it. It has to be a large jet parked at a boarding gate — the planes sitting out on the airfield do not count — and gates E3 and E4 are the easiest to reach. Taxi out and get airborne, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport; expect a 4-star wanted level the moment you move. A few seconds in the air is enough for some players, but flying clear of the airport is the safe version.
steps: Go to VCIA and find a large passenger jet at a boarding gate (E3 or E4 are easiest).
Board it, taxi out and take off.
Fly about 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and take out enemies from inside it. Get into the tank, then use its cannon on the soldiers or police who come after you — the trophy is about fighting from inside the Rhino, not just sitting in it. Expect heavy resistance, so keep moving and use the tank's armor.
steps: Go to Mile Zero Air Station and steal a Rhino tank.
Take out enemies from inside the tank.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. The quiet way in is the back door with the Snap Gun, which you get from Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs — so do those jobs first, then pick a jewelry store, slip in through the back, take the goods and leave without tripping an alarm or being spotted. If anyone sees you, it fails, so go in quiet and leave before the police arrive.
steps: Do Yasmani's Chapter 3 jobs to get the Snap Gun.
Pick a jewelry store and enter through the back door.
Rob it and leave without being detected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 vaults in the game. Vaults open up with an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault job brings a 4-star wanted level, so have a fast bike ready for the getaway before you go in. The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults, so keep robbing past five and this silver will pop on the way to 100%.
steps: Unlock vaults with the optional Chapter 4 mission.
Rob a bank vault and escape with a fast getaway vehicle ready.
Repeat for 5 vaults (8 for 100% completion).

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Find a truck on the road, stop it — ramming it or blocking it works — take the cash from the back and get away from the police. A bank vault job can also count toward this one if you escape, so you may pop it while working on Maximum Withdrawal without even trying.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it, take the cash and escape the police.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida: clear the fog from the whole map. Every area you have not visited stays fogged, so the job is to drive, fly or sail everywhere — all 52 areas. A plane is the fastest way to sweep the map, since you can cover the coast, the swamps and the Keys in a few passes. Check the map for fogged patches and mop them up one region at a time.
steps: Travel across Leonida to clear the map fog.
Use a plane to sweep large areas quickly.
Check the map for remaining fogged areas until the whole state is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. There are 39 operations in total, and the 100% checklist wants all of them, so this trophy is the first ninth of a much bigger job. Hit one operation per gang for the trophy, then keep going through the rest for 100%.
steps: Find illegal operations around Leonida.
Rob one operation from each of the 9 gangs.
All 39 operations are needed for 100% completion.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx). Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and order an Apple Martini. Then drink it while you are standing right next to the bar, and the trophy pops. That is the whole method: the right bar, the named drink, and staying by the bar while you drink it — no other cocktail or beachfront spot is needed.
steps: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar.
Buy an Apple Martini there.
Drink it while standing next to the bar; the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx). Steal the specific blue Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City — only that car works, no other vehicle counts. You can only take it once you have the Key Cloner, which comes from the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy. Use the cloner to hack into the blue Banshee, then drive forward straight through the showroom window. The trophy does not pop the instant you break the glass; it is slightly delayed and appears after you have driven further away down the street. It is an easter egg nodding to the Banshee from GTA III.
steps: Get the Key Cloner in Chapter 3, in the main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs.
Go to the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and hack into the blue Banshee.
Drive forward straight through the showroom window, then keep driving away — the trophy pops shortly after.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: This one is a robbery, not a game of bowling. It pops when you steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, a Gang Operation in Port Gellhorn: the luxury watch in the south-east office, marked with a golden icon; the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850, sitting on the table in the north-east corner, also marked with a golden icon; and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with Sticky Bombs — buy those first at an Ammu-Nation. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not the moment you grab the third item. If you do not take all 3 during the optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, the robbery icon comes back later and you can return for the ones you missed — it is not missable, and there is no need to get all 3 in one visit. Fighting the enemies is not required.
steps: Buy Sticky Bombs at an Ammu-Nation first.
At Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, take the luxury watch in the south-east office and the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner.
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway open with Sticky Bombs.
Escape the police; the trophy pops after you get away. Missed an item? The robbery icon respawns, so come back for it.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Check where you stand on the touchpad: open Jason & Lucia, pick a character and scroll to Strength, shown with a heart icon. You can only do this from Chapter 2's Coffee Break onward, when character switching opens up. Train together to make it faster: hold right and press triangle to call your partner over, and while you work out with one character the other finishes their training automatically too, so you make double progress. Find fitness clubs by filtering the map under Activities for the dumbbell icon. You can also work out at home once the story is over. It is a grind rather than a skill test: steady gym sessions across the playthrough will get both of them to the top.
steps: After Chapter 2's Coffee Break, check Strength on the touchpad under Jason & Lucia (heart icon).
Call your partner over (hold right + press triangle) and work out together so both gain at once.
Find fitness clubs via Map > Activities (dumbbell icon), or work out at home after the story.
Keep training until Strength is maxed for both Jason and Lucia.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. The profile tracks the choices you make as you play — lawful or criminal — and the counter climbs as you act. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. To watch it move as you play, turn on Criminal Profile notifications under Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile = On; a small demon face appears on the right side of the screen whenever you do something that affects your reputation. It will likely happen on its own during other trophies and the 100% run. If it still is not done by the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car — but be warned that cops shoot on sight more often once your profile reaches the psycho or irredeemable end. One warning from the guides: do not push your profile all the way to Irredeemable, because that profile state is permanent.
steps: Turn on Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On to see a demon-face icon when your reputation changes.
Play through the game making choices that change your Criminal Profile; check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions; if short at the end, farm them by running over civilians and cops with a car.
Do not push your profile to Irredeemable — it is permanent.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: STILL UNCONFIRMED — but PowerPyx now has a lead, updated 20 Nov 2026. The trophy is believed to be connected to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, possibly robbing it again later in a specific manner; that store sits in Vice City, in Little Cuba. That is a lead, not a confirmed method, so do not treat it as a fact yet: the old idea of just retrying things has been dropped from this guide. Try returning to that Payday Loans store later in the game and see what the robbery offers, and check back here when players have pinned the exact trigger down. This entry will not invent one.
steps: UNCONFIRMED lead (PowerPyx, 20 Nov 2026): believed to relate to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue, in Vice City — Little Cuba.
Try robbing that store again later in the game, in a specific manner — the exact manner is not yet known.
Do not chase it blindly; check back when the trigger is confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx, corroborated by GameRant). Complete the UFO Easter Egg. Take the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, at night after 2AM, and go alone. The spawn is slightly random, not guaranteed: at the roadside you will sometimes find a blinking car, and sometimes you will not. If the car is not there, drive away and come back later. When it is there, follow the path beside it into the woods and you will see the UFO — a bright blue light in the sky. Walk toward it and the UFO drops a woman it abducted. Talk to her and offer to help. She asks you to go back to her car at the roadside; do that and the trophy unlocks. GameRant adds the same shape of the event from the eastern Port Gellhorn area of Kelly County at around 2AM: an abandoned car, a track to follow, a woman floating in an abduction beam, a conversation, a drive back to her car, then an abduction scene and waking up three in-game days later.
steps: Go alone, at night after 2AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Look for the blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and return later — the spawn is random.
Follow the path by the car into the woods and approach the UFO's bright blue light.
Talk to the woman the UFO drops, offer to help, then go back to her car at the roadside as she asks.

sources.name: GameRant — GTA 6 UFO / Aliens Location (The Truth Is Out There Trophy)

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: NEWLY CONFIRMED 20 Nov 2026 (PowerPyx). Ride any bike — a motorcycle or a push bike — and kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds. That is the whole trick: ten kicks, one minute, from a bike. Do it somewhere crowded so the targets come to you, such as Vice City or Ocean Beach, and keep moving between kicks so the timer does not run out.
steps: Get on any bike (motorcycle or push bike).
Ride into a crowded area such as Vice City or Ocean Beach.
Kick 10 pedestrians with Square within 60 seconds.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. It is a running total, so every bill you fence adds up — you do not need $250,000 at once. Marked Bills come from banks and payday loan stores, and Yasmani pays the most for them, so fence through him whenever you can. This also counts toward the 100% checklist, which wants the same $250,000 fenced.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from banks and payday loan stores.
Launder them through your contacts; Yasmani pays the most.
Reach $250,000 fenced in total.

sources.name: The Gamers Hub — GTA 6 100% Completion Checklist

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops as a running total. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, ammo, food, anything bought in any shop — so it builds up naturally over a full playthrough. If you reach the endgame short of the total, the fastest way to close the gap is to buy expensive weapons and ammo. You will be spending heavily anyway on the garage properties for Little Boxes.
steps: Buy things in shops as you play; every shop purchase counts.
Reach $100,000 spent in total across all shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties that are for sale, for about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages you get through the story do not count — only the 8 you buy yourself. Garages are also useful for the Scooter Bros registrations in On the Spot, since you need free garage space to register vehicles, so buy the garages before you chase that trophy.
steps: Find the 8 garage properties for sale around Leonida.
Buy all 8 (about $160,000 in total).
Story garages do not count toward this trophy.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Moses gives you the app in Chapter 2, and you need free garage space to register a vehicle, so buy garage properties first (see Little Boxes) if you are full. Register any 10 vehicles you own or find; each registration counts once, so ten different vehicles will do it.
steps: Get the Scooter Bros app from Moses in Chapter 2.
Make sure you have free garage space.
Register 10 different vehicles to the app.

roadmap.title: Stage 1 — Play the story (Chapters 1–5)
roadmap.text: Play all five chapters in order and take the optional missions as they appear. Scan vehicles and study animals as you go — the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 of 255 animals, and progress made now already counts. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter: there is no mission replay. The one thing you must not skip: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, meditate with Lucia at Jason's house before the chapter ends — it is the only possibly missable trophy in the game (Positive Mental Attitude). Story trophies in this stage: the 5 chapter trophies, the 6 named-mission trophies and the final-mission gold.

roadmap.title: Stage 2 — Side quests, strangers and partner trophies
roadmap.text: After the story — or alongside it, as the quests appear — finish the side-character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone), hunt with Bret as Jason (his chain opens after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), and complete 8 Strangers & Freaks strands that count (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy and Billy do not). Do the partner trophies while both protagonists are available: lose a 4-star wanted level together, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing the heat, and max out Strength for both by training together. Try each activity type once for Master of None, and knock out the newly confirmed one-offs: the Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar, the blue Banshee showroom smash, and Ten Pin's ten bike kicks.

roadmap.title: Stage 3 — Post-story: the 100% checklist grind
roadmap.text: After the credits the 100% checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. It has 35 requirements, but most ask for only part of a set: 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets, 15 of 18 meditations, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons. The ones that demand everything are the robberies (22 banks, 7 payday loan stores, 35 Smash 'N' Grabs, 8 vaults), all 39 illegal operations, all 42 shooting-range golds, all 42 drone races and all of Bret's quests. Nothing on the checklist is missable. Finishing it earns the gold A Long Road.

roadmap.title: Stage 4 — Cleanup and the platinum
roadmap.text: Mop up whatever is left: the UFO Easter Egg for The Truth Is Out There (Kelly County, after 2AM, solo — the blinking car may take a few tries), the Bad Luck, I Guess lead at the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba (still unconfirmed — watch for an update), the 500 Criminal Profile actions for Actions Speak Louder, and any collectibles still short (cards, WAiNK locations, vehicles). When the last of the other 54 pops, the platinum Vice Got a Price! unlocks on its own. Total: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10 (PowerPyx).
